West Ham 2-3 Southampton: Saints claim thrilling win at the London Stadium
Report and free match highlights from the Sky Bet Championship match between West Ham United and Southampton at the London Stadium on Saturday; Saints record a thrilling win at the home of their promotion rivals.
Saturday 24 October 2026 18:31, UK
Southampton announced themselves in the Sky Bet Championship promotion race with a statement 3-2 win at pre-season title-favourites West Ham.
Kuryu Matsuki, James Bree and Lewis Dobbin were all on target in a chaotic first half, while Kyle Walker-Peters and Tomas Soucek replied for the Hammers.
Nuno Espirito Santo's side, relegated on the final day of last term, would have gone top with a win but instead saw their nine-match unbeaten run grind to a halt.
There were thousands of empty seats by the end at the London Stadium, with those who stayed booing the Hammers off.
For anyone who thought promotion would be achieved at a canter in east London, this was a wake-up call.
The Hammers now have a Southampton side, who were deducted four points at the start of the season, in their rear-view mirror, lying just two points behind.
Saints took the lead inside two minutes after Konstantinos Mavropanos and Divine Mukasa stood back and admired as Leo Scienza danced into the penalty area.
Scienza blasted his shot straight at Hammers goalkeeper Mads Hermansen, who made a fine point-blank save, but the rebound rolled to Matsuki who tucked it into the opposite corner.
West Ham tried to hit straight back with Walker-Peters finding Jarrod Bowen, who cut inside but dragged his shot wide.
However, the hosts were two down after 10 minutes when Casper Jander's cross was tipped away by Hermansen as far as Bree, who without breaking stride lashed a spectacular volley into the roof of the net.
Mukasa almost made amends for his earlier error when he won the ball off Ryan Manning and jinked inside Scienza only to see his shot deflected wide.
West Ham did claw one back when former Saint Walker-Peters skipped past Jander on the edge of the box and launched a rocket into the top corner.
The Hammers were pressing incessantly for an equaliser but then promptly shot themselves in the foot as more lacklustre defending allowed Finn Azaz to shoot straight at Hermansen, with Dobbin this time snaffling the rebound.
The unlikely figure of Mavropanos almost pulled one back after the break but his rasping drive was well saved by Daniel Peretz, before fellow centre-half Max Kilman trotted forward and crashed a shot against the crossbar.
Arne Engels then took aim from the edge of the box but Peretz saved with his legs, which was the cue for scores of West Ham fans to make their way towards the exits with 10 minutes still remaining.
Those who left missed substitute Soucek curling in a consolation in stoppage time, before Peretz kept out a header from Taty Castellanos to preserve three points for Saints.

The managers
West Ham head coach Nuno Espirito Santo:
"We started not the way we wanted and we conceded. We were looking at the situations with hesitation, bouncing balls, too many chances for Southampton to have a second phase, third phase and achieve a goal.
"We were not good in that moment, but the reaction was good. After you start playing, you start combining, you create enormous situations.
"The score was still on top of us, though, and the third goal punished us. Overall, in the first half, we didn't do things well enough to try and dominate and control Southampton.
"In the second half, the response was good. We tried, many situations that we could have done better. The boys fought until the end.
"The fans helped us. All of us were having the feeling that we were able to react and revert the game, but it was not to be. It was disappointing."
Southampton head coach Tonda Eckert:
"This is a tough place to come, against a quality team, and we knew we needed to start strongly, so we worked on that all week.
"That costs a lot of energy, so we had to make sure we went up in that period.
"They made it tough for us in the second half, so it was important that we stayed brave to bring the result over the line.
"We were clinical today, more than in our last three games, and you could see the togetherness of the whole group."

סאות'המפטון הפתיעה את וסטהאם יונייטד המדורגת גבוה בצ'מפיונשיפ עם ניצחון 3-2 מרתק באצטדיון לונדון. האורחים פתחו בסערה וכבשו שלושה שערים במחצית ראשונה סוערת מרגליהם של קוריו מאצוקי, ג'יימס ברי ולואיס דובבין, בעוד קייל ווקר-פיטרס צימק עבור המארחים לפני ההפסקה.

במחצית השנייה הפעילה וסטהאם לחץ כבד על שערה של סאות'המפטון, ותומאש סוצ'ק הצליח להבקיע שער נוסף בתוספת הזמן, אך השוער דניאל פרץ ומספר הצלות דרמטיות הבטיחו את הניצחון היקר לסאות'המפטון והשאירו את וסטהאם מאוכזבת בסיום.
